lesson.title: Chipotle's E. Coli Outbreak (2015)
lesson.body: Food-safety scandal cut traffic and the stock roughly halved. Yet the underlying economics — high unit-level margins, no debt, customers who came back within months, industry-leading same-store recovery — were intact. A classic 'surface-level wound, healthy organs' fallen angel. Lesson: ask whether the crisis permanently removed the reason customers chose the business in the first place.
